title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 23
description: Ten questions on Genesis 23: the death of Sarah and Abraham's purchase of the cave of Machpelah.

questions.explanation: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah's life.
Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan.

questions.text: To whom did Abraham speak about a burial place?
questions.explanation: Abraham rose up from before his dead and spoke to the children of Heth.

questions.text: How did Abraham describe himself to the children of Heth?
questions.explanation: Abraham said, "I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you."

answers.text: As a stranger and a foreigner
As an old man near death

questions.text: What did the children of Heth call Abraham?
questions.explanation: The children of Heth said, "Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs."

answers.text: A prince of God among us

questions.explanation: Abraham asked them to entreat for him to Ephron the son of Zohar.

questions.text: What does the text call Ephron?
questions.explanation: Ephron was sitting among the children of Heth, and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham.

questions.text: What did Ephron first offer Abraham?
questions.explanation: Ephron said, "I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it... Bury your dead."

answers.text: To lend him the cave for a year
To give him the field and the cave
To sell him only the cave
To let him bury Sarah in Ephron's own tomb

questions.text: How much silver did Abraham weigh out to Ephron?
questions.explanation: Abraham weighed to Ephron four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants' standard.

questions.text: In which cave did Abraham bury Sarah?
questions.explanation: Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.
